scope: Deterministic Three.js + GSAP motion and actual GLB hierarchy; no render/FPS claim

results.check: Sixteen independent components move over their schedules; hierarchy, other assets and all scales stay intact
Drone remains world-vertical and within 6 cm under rotated, 1.14-scaled parent
Reduced motion performs zero transform writes
Modal/drag disable pauses transforms and motion time; resume matches uninterrupted active time
Hover ownership excludes both ancestors and descendants, while unrelated pieces keep moving
Click hold covers the whole related assembly, survives disabled time, and resumes only after active hold time
Real GSAP rotation/position/quaternion tweens own their transforms even after click hold expires
Long tab delta is clamped; negative delta cannot rewind the motion clock
Chair completes repeated full revolutions around a fixed parent-vertical swivel with no reverse jump
Actual mechanical face normals, fixed pivots, lens travel and enclosed sculpture use the intended axes
Actual chair sweep keeps a separating floor-plane gap to the workstation across the full 360 degrees at 1-degree samples
results.limitation: Desk footprint check across the full 360 degrees at 1-degree samples; not continuous full-room collision detection

results.check: Actual active GLB keeps every asset independently addressable, with bounded drone movement
